newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police detain suspected Kurd PKK militants.
newsitem.headline: French police detain suspected Kurd PKK militants.

text.p: French police detained on Tuesday eight Turkish nationals suspected of being militants of the PKK separatist group, justice sources said.
The sources said the eight, who were ordered held in custody by a Paris anti-terrorism magistrate, were detained in the Paris suburbs of Villeneuve-Saint-Georges and Clichy.
They are suspected of extorting funds under the cover of fictitious companies, and of helping recruit young fighters for the struggle waged since 1984 by the movement against Ankara.
Some 20 presumed members of the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) are held under preventive custody in France in separate probes into the funding of the movement.
Several associations believed to have served as legal fronts for the PKK have been dissolved by government decrees.
